nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

**Key inputs**

- **prompt**: describe the shots, camera moves, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

Realistic live-action documentary look, cinematic, natural light, slight film grain, shot on 35mm.

Scene: a busy European old-town street at morning rush hour in spring 2020, just before lockdown. Four-storey brick and plaster facades with shop fronts, a tram line down the middle, cobbled pavement. A tram passes, cars and delivery vans queue, cyclists weave through, crowds of commuters walk fast on both pavements. A passenger airplane crosses low through a hazy grey sky above the rooftops, leaving a contrail. Grey overcast light, light smog haze, busy and slightly stressful.

Camera: locked-off tripod wide shot at eye level from the pavement, looking down the length of the street, no camera movement. One continuous shot, no cuts.

Audio: loud city ambience, traffic rumble, tram bell, footsteps, distant jet engine. No music, no dialogue, no voices.

Realistic live-action wildlife documentary look, cinematic, natural light, slight film grain, sharp focus, anatomically correct animals.

Scene: dawn in spring 2020, an empty two-lane asphalt country road along the edge of a European beech forest, light mist over the fields. No cars at all. One adult red deer hind walks slowly and calmly across the road from left to right, seen clearly in side profile, at a steady natural walking pace. Her four slender legs move in a correct, natural deer gait, each hoof landing cleanly on the asphalt, legs stay fully visible and never overlap or blur. On the grass verge behind her, a red fox sits still and watches. Golden low sunlight, dew on the grass, peaceful.

Camera: locked-off medium-wide shot from the roadside at deer height, road running straight across the frame, the deer large and centred in frame, telephoto lens, no camera movement. One continuous shot, no cuts, smooth natural motion.

Audio: birdsong, soft hooves on asphalt, rustling grass. No traffic, no music, no dialogue, no voices.

Scene: the same two-lane asphalt country road along the edge of a European forest, shown in time-lapse as normal life returns after lockdown. The shot opens on the quiet empty road in soft morning light, a red deer hind standing at the forest edge. Then traffic floods back onto the road in fast motion, cars and trucks streaming in both directions, headlights streaking. In the sky above, airplane contrails multiply one after another. The red deer turns away and bounds back into the trees. The light gradually turns grey and hazy.

Camera: low-angle locked-off time-lapse from the roadside, road running diagonally through the frame, no camera movement. One continuous shot, no cuts.

Audio: starts with birdsong, then traffic noise swells quickly to a loud rumble, engines, a distant jet. No music, no dialogue, no voices.

nodes.title: Shot 08 — Which one?
Note: The Pause — edit notes
widgets_values:
## The Pause — final settings

- Resolution 16:9, megapixels 1.0 (1344x768), 24 fps
- turbo_mode **false** on every shot (full quality)
- Output: `the_pause/final/shot01` … `shot08`
- Total runtime 35 s (4+4+4+4+4+5+4+6)

Tip: select a shot's nodes and press Ctrl+B to bypass it, so you can queue one shot at a time.

## Edit notes (shot 08)
Text cards over the black end of shot 08:
"What if the pause had become a transition?" then, 1 s later and smaller, "2030 is four years away."

Fallback if the split screen isn't clean: composite the left half from shot01 and the right half from shot07 in the editor.

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
